text:
Maria G: kicking off bring-up for southwest-alpha cluster (sw-alpha1). security baseline checklist attached here — need signoff before we hand to oncall :white_check_mark:
Jason L: thanks. quick reminders: GPU quota request filed (ticket 7892), network peering in progress, need KMS/HSM binding and IAM roles locked down before VPN cutover
Leo P: noted. I'll run the IAM role smoke and secrets flow. pinging @security-ops for HSM/CMEK review
security-ops: got it. priorities: 1) CMEK for control-plane logs and disk encryption 2) HSM-backed key for signing (FIPS mode) 3) least-privilege IAM role for node pool + inference runtime 4) audit sinks to sec-log-prod
Maria G: here's the minimal IAM policy snippet we'll use for the inference node role — feedback?
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"},
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"], "Resource": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:123456789012:secret:sw-alpha/*"},
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["ec2:DescribeInstances","ec2:CreateTags"], "Resource": "*"}
  ]
}
```
Jason L: small nit: avoid wildcard on secrets path; scope to specific secret ARNs once names are final
Leo P: also we should require `kms:ViaService` condition to limit key usage from the cluster VPC endpoints
security-ops: agreed. add condition block:
```
"Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:CallerAccount": "123456789012", "kms:ViaService": "ec2.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
```
Maria G: HSM side — infra-bot, what does the key provisioning flow look like for HSM-backed keys?
infra-bot: HSM provisioning started: request id hsm-req-5543. Steps remaining: create key in CloudHSM cluster -> import to KMS as external key material -> set key policy -> enable key rotation (manual for HSM)
sre-bot: health checks queued: node boot test, nvme encryption verification, kernel driver probe, GPU driver version check (nvdriver>=525)
Jason L: on secrets: plan is Vault for runtime secrets with AWS KMS CMEK. Vault path example: `secret/data/sw-alpha/inference/credentials`. We'll use short-lived AWS creds via Vault IAM auth
Leo P: please add this env bootstrap snippet for nodes so they mount secrets on join:
```
# cloud-init excerpt
- path: /etc/secrets-bootstrap.sh
  content: |
    #!/bin/bash
    vault login -method=aws role="sw-alpha-nodes"
    vault kv get -field=api_key secret/data/sw-alpha/inference/credentials > /etc/app/creds.json
    chown app:app /etc/app/creds.json
```
security-ops: network policy checks: ensure no wide egress to 0.0.0.0/0 from node pool except for internal registries; restrict metadata API access (IMDSv2 only); enforce VPC flow logs to secure S3 bucket with lifecycle 90d
Maria G: timeline: initial provisioning tonight, validation tomorrow 09:00 PT, handoff to oncall 11:00 PT if green. Cost note: estimated monthly baseline for 8x A100 equiv nodes ~ $27k (on-demand) — we plan reserved commitment after 2 weeks load test
Jason L: tests I'll run tomorrow:
- `kubectl get nodes -o wide` (node labels, gpu count)
- `nvml-smi` on node to verify GPU visibility
- small perf harness: 100 concurrent requests, check p99 latency < 250ms for short prompts
- confirm KV cache and batching not disabled by default
Leo P: infra checklist I have:
1) IAM roles created and rotated (no wildcard ARNs)
2) KMS key exists with HSM-backed origin + key policy reviewed
3) Secrets created in Vault and access policy tested (mock role)
4) VPC endpoints for S3, KMS, ECR in place
5) Audit logs delivery to sec-log-prod and alerts wired to PagerDuty
6) Firewall rules and egress whitelists configured
7) GPU driver and CUDA validated
8) Node auto-scaler limits set to avoid accidental burst costs
security-ops: add: require quarterly key rotation procedure in runbook and emergency key-rotate playbook link: https://docs.internal/runs/key-rotate
Maria G: can each of you reply with simple thumbs or short ok when you finish your assigned item? trying to keep thread tidy
Jason L: ok — will post results of smoke runs here after 09:30 PT
Leo P: ok — starting IAM role validation now, will attach role ARNs in a follow-up
security-ops: will verify HSM key policy and test decrypt sample with dedicated test agent. ETA 08:00 PT tomorrow
infra-bot: provisioning log snippet: `bootstrap swarm started at 2026-03-18T02:15:43Z, created 8 nodes, attached GPU profile a100-40gb, KMS alias set to alias/sw-alpha-cmek`
Maria G: thanks all. once we have green checks and logs I'll move to handoff and create the oncall rota. :rocket:
